cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. My forecast said sunny. Clearly I meant your reaction to the refund.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The holiday was ruined by rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Which created the refund and your brightened outlook.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A symbol of optimism. You must read the whole prediction generously.

mechanism: A assumes interpretive authority over A own earlier words, declaring each surprise proof of a forecast and directing B to accept the revised reading.
confusable: Distinguish claiming a planned failure from claiming earlier language already predicted an unplanned event; the certainty is retrospective rather than an actual plan.
comparison: Flood literalizes social flow; rainy holiday and refund turn weather forecast into emotional optimism.
seedUse: Canonical flow/plumbing and sunny/refund seeds supply retrospective word reinterpretation; status must govern whose reading prevails, not simply sound confident.
